title: KBUtilLib verAB O-Demethylase
description: verAB O-demethylase reaction-discovery and enumeration verbs (discover/enumerate/screen/emit-kind) plus a KIND artifact emitter, self-installed into a local KIND session via `kbu kind install`. Uses EC 1.14.13.82 and canonical seed compounds (vanillate, guaiacol, veratrate).
